# Tervy 0.1.11
Saved notes in **Library → Notes** now open as rendered Markdown. Click the pencil icon next to the note title to edit the title or Markdown. **Save** shows the updated preview, and **Discard** returns to the last saved version. New notes open directly in the editor.
To try it, create a note with a Markdown heading, a bulleted list, and a fenced code block. Save it, then use the pencil icon to make a change and save again.
## Install or update
In Tervy, choose **Settings → Check for updates → Install update**. Tervy asks before stopping running sessions. For a new installation, open the Apple Silicon DMG from this release and drag Tervy to Applications.
Tervy supports Apple Silicon Macs on macOS 15 or later. Experimental meeting recording and Teams reminders require macOS 26 or later.

# Tervy 0.1.10
Tervy can now remind you to record a Microsoft Teams meeting. On macOS 26 or later, sustained audio activity from desktop Teams brings Tervy forward with a **Teams meeting detected** prompt, even when Tervy is hidden.
Choose **Record…** to open the recording and notes options, or **Dismiss** (Escape) to skip that call. Reminders are enabled by default and can be turned off in **Settings → Teams meeting reminders**. Your preference is remembered. The detector does not capture audio, and nothing is recorded until you choose a recording option. Existing recordings suppress reminders.
## Help test Teams detection
This first version uses Teams microphone or speaker activity rather than a meeting API. Expect a reminder roughly 6–9 seconds after sustained activity begins. Muted meetings can be detected through speaker activity. Prejoin audio checks and other sustained Teams audio may also trigger a reminder. Teams in a browser is not detected. Use **Stop** to finish recording.
Please try joining, muting, leaving, and rejoining a desktop Teams call, including with Tervy hidden. Report missed or repeated prompts through [GitHub Issues](https://github.com/jringeisen/tervy/issues), including your macOS and Teams versions. Avoid attaching private meeting audio or transcripts.
## Install or update
Open **Settings** in Tervy and check for updates, then choose **Install update**. Tervy asks before stopping running sessions.
For a new installation, download the Apple Silicon DMG from this release, open it, and drag Tervy to Applications. Tervy supports Apple Silicon Macs running macOS 15 or later. Experimental meeting recording and Teams reminders require macOS 26 or later.

# Tervy 0.1.9
Text areas now grow and shrink to fit their content, including wrapped lines. This applies to note content, the new-note dialog, skill content, supporting files, and meeting notes. Very long content remains scrollable once the field reaches its height limit.
## Install or update
Open **Settings** in Tervy and check for updates, then choose **Install update**. Tervy asks before stopping running sessions.
For a new installation, download the Apple Silicon DMG from this release, open it, and drag Tervy to Applications. Tervy supports Apple Silicon Macs running macOS 15 or later. Experimental meeting recording requires macOS 26 or later.
See the [README](https://github.com/jringeisen/tervy#readme) for your first project and optional coding agent setup.

# Tervy 0.1.8
This update makes the sidebar match light mode. Its background, project panels, selected rows, dividers, section icons, and labels now use light colors with readable contrast. Dark mode keeps its existing appearance.
## Install or update
If you already have Tervy 0.1.7, open **Settings** when the update badge appears and choose **Install update**. Tervy asks before stopping running sessions.
For a new installation, download the Apple Silicon DMG from this release, open it, and drag Tervy to Applications. Tervy supports Apple Silicon Macs running macOS 15 or later. Experimental meeting recording requires macOS 26 or later.
See the [README](https://github.com/jringeisen/tervy#readme) for your first project and optional coding agent setup.

# Tervy 0.1.7
First public beta for Apple Silicon Macs running macOS 15 or later.
Tervy brings project terminals, processes, and coding agents into one workspace. This release adds a shared Notes library, skill browsing and editing, improved meeting and agent workflows, and visual refinements including the sidebar status glow.
## In-app updates
This is the first build with in-app updates. Tervy checks for new releases and marks the Settings gear when one is available. Open Settings to check manually or install an update. Tervy asks before stopping running sessions for installation.
If you have an earlier Tervy build, replace it with this DMG once. Later releases can be installed from the app.
## Install
Download `Tervy-0.1.7-macos-arm64.dmg`, open it, and drag Tervy to Applications. Quit an older Tervy build before replacing it. Existing local data is migrated on first launch; back up important data before upgrading.
Coding agents are optional and require their own CLIs and sign-in. Meeting recording is experimental and requires macOS 26 or later.
See the [README](https://github.com/jringeisen/tervy#readme) for setup, backup, and support details.
